The fixed-family tangent search has produced no separation; its best fields collapse to single-wave limits. The pointwise SOS support route also remains uncertified.

I’m broadening the same mechanism to all homogeneous quartics of a two-dimensional scalar Hessian. Their ROC condition has a lossless small PSD formulation, so this tests a substantially larger cone without angular sampling.
